name: Solar Shield Bash
description: Slam enemies with concentrated divine sunlight, dealing 150% damage and stunning target legions for 3 seconds.

name: Aegis of the Dawn
description: Deploys a radiant dome of energy that absorbs up to 50,000 damage for all vanguard and auxiliary allied forces.

name: Hurricane Bow Volley
description: Fires a rapid gale barrage of 10 wind-charged arrows, each dealing 45% attack power over a wide arc.

name: Gale-Force Alacrity
description: Increases overall marching speed and movement of all deployed map expedition forces by 15%.

name: Temporal Singularity
description: Creates a localized time vortex, slowing enemy action and recovery speeds by 40% inside its visual boundary.

name: Echoes of Eternity
description: Instantly triggers a 1-hour construction and academy research speedup. Cooldown: 12 hours.

name: Earthbreaker Shatter
description: Slams the volcanic hammer, fracturing the ground to deal 180% armor-piercing damage to the nearest defender squads.
